line9

beta2
' > beta.txt && printf 'doc1
' > notes.md && git add . && git commit -qm seed

arguments.title: draft and show
arguments.code:
d = await commit.draft()
print('---SHOW_ALL---')
await d.show()
print('---SHOW_ALPHA---')
await d.show('alpha.txt')

arguments.title: drop and take by unit, path, grep, and only
arguments.code:
await d.drop('alpha.txt', '2')
await d.take('alpha.txt', grep='line9_agent')
await d.drop('beta.txt')
await d.take('beta.txt')
await d.only('alpha.txt', '*.md')
print('---DIFF---')
patch = await d.diff()
print('PATCH_LEN_OK:', len(patch) > 0)

arguments.title: commit with subject body and fixes
arguments.code:
res = await d.commit('feat: selective update', ['- Updated alpha and notes.'], fixes=42, silent=True)
sha = res['sha']
assert len(sha) == 40 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in sha)
print(repr(d).replace(sha[:10], '<SHA10>'))
print('COMMIT_PATHS:', res['paths'])
print('COMMIT_SUBJECT:', res['subject'])

arguments.command: git log -1 --format='SUBJECT=%s%nBODY=%B' && git show --name-only --format= HEAD && git status --porcelain

name: commit-hooks-noverify-and-amend
description: Failing pre-commit hook aborts commit leaving HEAD and index intact; noVerify bypasses hook; amend replaces the session's own commit.
setup:
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2025-01-02T03:04:05+0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2025-01-02T03:04:05+0000' && git init -q -b main && git config user.email test@example.com && git config user.name Test && git config commit.gpgSign false && git config core.autocrlf false && printf 'v0
' > app.txt && printf 'u0
' > user.txt && git add . && git commit -qm seed && printf 'u_staged
' > user.txt && git add user.txt && printf '#!/bin/sh
echo "hook rejected this commit" >&2
exit 1
' > .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit

arguments.title: failing hook then no_verify
arguments.code:
d = await commit.draft()
try:
    await d.commit('feat: v1')
except Exception as e:
    print('HOOK_FAILED:', 'hook rejected this commit' in str(e))
print('AFTER_FAIL_COUNT:', sh('git rev-list --count HEAD').strip())
print('AFTER_FAIL_STAGED:', sh('git diff --cached --name-only').strip())
res1 = await d.commit('feat: v1', no_verify=True, silent=True)
print('COMMIT1_PATHS:', res1['paths'])

arguments.title: amend own commit with no_verify
arguments.code:
d2 = await commit.draft(silent=True)
print(repr(d2).replace(d2.details['head'][:10], '<SHA10>'))
res2 = await d2.commit('feat: v2 amended', amend=True, no_verify=True, silent=True)
print('AMENDED_IS_SET:', bool(res2.get('amended')))
print('AMENDED_PATHS:', res2['paths'])
print('FINAL_COUNT:', sh('git rev-list --count HEAD').strip())
print('FINAL_SUBJECT:', sh('git log -1 --format=%s').strip())
print('FINAL_APP:', sh('git show HEAD:app.txt').strip())
print('FINAL_STAGED:', sh('git diff --cached --name-only').strip())

name: commit-merge-detached-empty-maxdrafts-stale
description: In-progress merge refused, detached HEAD commits cleanly, empty repo makes root commit, >MAX_DRAFTS expires oldest, and second draft after first commits handles stale/moved HEAD.
setup:
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2025-01-02T03:04:05+0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2025-01-02T03:04:05+0000' && mkdir -p merge_repo detached_repo empty_repo multi_repo conflict_repo && git -C merge_repo init -q -b main && git -C merge_repo config user.email t@e.com && git -C merge_repo config user.name T && git -C merge_repo config commit.gpgSign false && printf 'base
' > merge_repo/c.txt && git -C merge_repo add . && git -C merge_repo commit -qm base && git -C merge_repo checkout -qb side && printf 'side
' > merge_repo/c.txt && git -C merge_repo add . && git -C merge_repo commit -qm side && git -C merge_repo checkout -q main && printf 'main
' > merge_repo/c.txt && git -C merge_repo add . && git -C merge_repo commit -qm main && (git -C merge_repo merge side || true) && git -C detached_repo init -q -b main && git -C detached_repo config user.email t@e.com && git -C detached_repo config user.name T && git -C detached_repo config commit.gpgSign false && printf 'd0
' > detached_repo/d.txt && git -C detached_repo add . && git -C detached_repo commit -qm seed && git -C detached_repo checkout -q --detach HEAD && git -C empty_repo init -q -b main && git -C empty_repo config user.email t@e.com && git -C empty_repo config user.name T && git -C empty_repo config commit.gpgSign false && git -C multi_repo init -q -b main && git -C multi_repo config user.email t@e.com && git -C multi_repo config user.name T && git -C multi_repo config commit.gpgSign false && printf 'a0
' > multi_repo/a.txt && printf 'b0
' > multi_repo/b.txt && git -C multi_repo add . && git -C multi_repo commit -qm seed && git -C conflict_repo init -q -b main && git -C conflict_repo config user.email t@e.com && git -C conflict_repo config user.name T && git -C conflict_repo config commit.gpgSign false && printf 'x0
' > conflict_repo/x.txt && git -C conflict_repo add . && git -C conflict_repo commit -qm seed

arguments.title: merge refused, detached HEAD, empty repo, stale draft
arguments.code:
dm = await commit.draft(repo='merge_repo', silent=True)
try:
    await dm.commit('fix: during merge', silent=True)
except Exception as e:
    print('MERGE_ERR:', e)

dd = await commit.draft(repo='detached_repo', silent=True)
print('DETACHED_SUMMARY_LINE0:', repr(dd).splitlines()[0])
rd = await dd.commit('fix: detached', silent=True)
print('DETACHED_HEADER:', repr(dd).splitlines()[0].replace(rd['sha'][:10], '<SHA10>'))

de = await commit.draft(repo='empty_repo', silent=True)
print('EMPTY_SUMMARY_LINE0:', repr(de).splitlines()[0])
re_out = await de.commit('feat: root', silent=True)
print('EMPTY_PARENT:', re_out['parent'])
print('EMPTY_PATHS:', re_out['paths'])

d1 = await commit.draft(repo='multi_repo', silent=True)
d2 = await commit.draft(repo='multi_repo', silent=True)
await d1.only('a.txt', silent=True)
r1 = await d1.commit('feat: a only', silent=True)
print('D1_PATHS:', r1['paths'])
await d2.drop('a.txt', silent=True)
r2 = await d2.commit('feat: b on moved HEAD', silent=True)
print('D2_CLEAN_NOTE:', 'HEAD had moved to ' + r1['sha'][:10] + '; the selection applied cleanly on top.' in repr(d2))
print('D2_PATHS:', r2['paths'])

dc = await commit.draft(repo='conflict_repo', silent=True)
sh("printf 'x_other\\n' > conflict_repo/x.txt && git -C conflict_repo add x.txt && git -C conflict_repo commit -qm other")
try:
    await dc.commit('fix: stale conflict', silent=True)
except Exception as e:
    print('STALE_CONFLICT_ERR:', e)
